title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.

examples.explanation: The value 1 appears at indices 0 and 3.

approach: Maintain a set of values already encountered. If the current value is in the set, a duplicate has been found; otherwise insert it and continue. Hash-set membership and insertion are O(1) expected time, making the full scan O(n) expected time. If all values are distinct, the set contains n entries, so auxiliary space is O(n).
